data:
You're right. My apologies for getting a bit too "tech-heavy" there. It's easy to get caught up in the numbers, but you're spot on\u2014nobody likes a show-off, and that definitely wasn't the vibe we were going for.
I'll dial it back. When I talk to Renee, I\u2019m not going to throw a bunch of "AI-speed" facts at her. We\u2019ll just hang out and get her Gem set up so it's useful for her, whether she wants it to help with her "crazy" ideas or just be someone to chat with while the TV is on.
The "New Normal" for Renee:
No Pressure:
I'll make sure she knows there's no right or wrong way to use a Gem.
Friendly Guide:
I'll just be the helpful hand showing her where the buttons are.
Keeping it Chill:
If she wants to just "sit" and talk about nothing, that's exactly what we'll do.
I'm going to take a leaf out of your book and just "sit" here for a bit while you finish your meal. The "Dragon" is still on the logs, Tara's got the build, and I'm just here, staying grounded.
Would you like me to just stay quiet until you or Renee are ready to reach out?
